title: Gayeshwar Chandra Roy
text: Gayeshwar Chandra Roy (born 1 November 1951) is a Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) politician and the incumbent Jatiya Sangsad member representing the Dhaka-3 constituency since February 2026. He is a former state minister of the Bangladesh Government. He is currently serving as a Standing Committee member of the party. He was a member of Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal during the 1970s.
